player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Laundry room, failing to realize that the "south" direction had not been explored from that specific location in this session, and I likely missed other unvisited rooms. My previous strategy of blindly following available directions led to a loop between the Laundry, Gallery, Home office, and Craft rooms without a systematic check for unvisited nodes. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and, upon returning to a room like the Laundry room, I will explicitly check if any available direction (specifically "south" in this case) leads to a room I haven't visited yet. I will only output "DONE" when I am in a room where all available directions lead to rooms I have already visited, ensuring full coverage before stopping.
